newsitem.title: UK: IEA sees fast rise in Gulf of Mexico oil output.
newsitem.headline: IEA sees fast rise in Gulf of Mexico oil output.

text.p: Seven new oilfields are likely to come onstream in deep Gulf of Mexico waters in 1998 in addition to four new fields this year, the International Energy Agency (IEA) said on Tuesday.
"The rate of new field discoveries in the deep water of the Gulf of Mexico seems to be accelerating with new projects being reported almost every month," the IEA said in a monthly oil market report.
The agency said it had identified 37 projects set to be developed in the period 1995-2000.
Five fields started in both 1995 and 1996, adding 203,000 bpd of extra supplies by the end of last year.
The fields, together with four new starts this year, would provide 450,000 bpd on average in 1997, the IEA said.
Incremental volumes from the projects and more new fields would add 691,000 bpd next year rising to 939,000 bpd in 1999 and 1.235 million bpd in 2000, the agency projected.
